lines.text: Many learners say: I will see you the next week.
Better: I will see you next week.
We do not say the before next.

data.wrong: I will see you the next week.
data.right: I will see you next week.
data.why: We do not say the before next.

native.tip: En français, on dit « la semaine prochaine ». En anglais, pas de “the” : on dit “next week”.
